children: Russia's largest producer of liquefied natural gas (LNG),  Novatek
, is in advanced talks on supplies to Vietnam and hopes to start deliveries next year, chief executive Leonid Mikhelson said on Wednesday.
Novatek signed a preliminary contract with a buyer from Vietnam in March this year, when state news agency TASS said it was discussing the supply of 1 million tonnes.
